product_family: AI-native contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform enabling automated drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of contracts with integrated e-signature and AI-powered analytics.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Juro maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation to provide comfort to its customers about the security safeguards Juro has in place. Each year, our security program and systems are inspected by independent assessors to measure our compliance against rigorous standards across five trust service principles.

certifications.name: Cyber Essentials (IASME)
certifications.proof_quote: Juro maintains a Cyber Essentials certification from IASME to evidence its compliance with the security principle under the UK GDPR and EU GDPR.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found. Juro commits to maintaining SOC 2 Type II and Cyber Essentials as primary security certifications in their DPA, with no mention of ISO 27001.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence or claim of HIPAA compliance. Juro is a contract management platform not positioned as a healthcare-focused solution.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification mentioned in trust center or security documentation.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification. Despite significant AI features (AI Assistant, AI Review, AI Extract), Juro does not advertise AI governance certifications.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Cloud Security Alliance STAR certification mentioned in trust center or security documentation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification mentioned. Juro is not marketed as a government-authorized cloud service.

privacy.ai_training_note: Juro explicitly states: 'If you use our AI Assistant, we don't - and we don't allow our AI technology providers to - use your data to train any models, except for models that are used only by your business.' Customer contracts and metadata are not used for model training.
privacy.data_region: EEA (AWS Ireland for main data storage; processing in London and Riga; third-party AI processing via Microsoft Azure in EEA)

security.name: Incident Response

security.name: Secure Coding
security.value: OWASP Secure Coding Practices Version 2.1 compliance; dedicated application security team

security.name: Uptime & Availability
